description: backend.rs: MailboxProperty, ThreadProperty, EmailProperty, IdentityProperty, EmailSubmissionProperty, VacationResponseProperty, SearchSnippetProperty all derive Debug, Clone, PartialEq but not Hash or Eq. Properties are used as selectors (essentially enum-keyed sets), and callers who want to check 'does this property set include X?' or put them in a HashSet must use Vec::contains() (O(n)) rather than HashSet::contains() (O(1)). Adding #[derive(Eq, Hash)] alongside PartialEq is zero-cost and unlocks idiomatic usage.
title: Property selector enums (MailboxProperty, EmailProperty, etc.) missing Hash derive
